titulo.estudio: ちいき の こうれいか
titulo.alumno: Reading: evaluating a measure for the neighbourhood

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: In a report, separate the observed figure, the proposed measure and the uncertainties the text acknowledges.
texto: A figure alone doesn't prove that a measure caused a change. Look at the period, the groups and the author's reservations.

市 の 報告 に よると、駅前 の 高齢者 向け 施設 は この 五年 で 利用 が 二割 増えた。一方、郊外 では 移動 手段 が 少なく、予約 の 取り消し も 多い。 (According to the municipal report, use of the facilities for elderly people near the station has grown by twenty per cent in five years. On the other hand, the outskirts have few means of transport and many cancellations.)

市 は 来年度、送迎 の 実証 運行 を 始める。ただし、対象 は 三地区 に 限り、半年後 に 利用者 の 意見 を 調べて 続ける か 判断 する。 (The city will start a trial transport service next year. However, it will cover only three districts, and six months later it will decide whether to continue after reviewing users' opinions.)
